Game Overview

Yummy Super Burger puts players into a girls' experience centered on craft delicious burgers in a sizzling culinary adventure. Master each step, from slicing ingredients to serving customers, with an emphasis on speed and precision. Enjoy intuitive controls as you multitask and manage time effectively to satisfy every craving and keep your kitchen bustling.
